title: Present simple + in / on / at
title_it: Present simple e in / on / at
goal: Talk about routines and facts, and use at, on and in with time.
goal_it: Parlare di routine e fatti e usare at, on e in con il tempo.

title: Present continuous
goal: Talk about what is happening now and use the -ing form correctly.
goal_it: Parlare di ciò che sta accadendo adesso e usare correttamente la forma -ing.

title: Listening: A phone call at the station
goal: Understand a short phone call, and practise telling the time and the present continuous.
goal_it: Capire una breve telefonata ed esercitare l'ora e il present continuous.

title: Present simple vs continuous + adverbs of frequency
title_it: Present simple vs continuous + avverbi di frequenza
goal: Choose between present simple and continuous and place adverbs of frequency correctly.
goal_it: Scegliere tra present simple e continuous e collocare correttamente gli avverbi di frequenza.

title: Writing: A typical day
goal: Write about your daily routine with the present simple, frequency adverbs and the present continuous.
goal_it: Scrivere della tua routine con present simple, avverbi di frequenza e present continuous.

title: Weekly check: present simple and continuous
title_it: Verifica della settimana: present simple e continuous
goal: Check the week: present simple, present continuous, in / on / at and adverbs of frequency, plus a short reading.
goal_it: Verificare la settimana: present simple, present continuous, in / on / at e avverbi di frequenza, più una breve lettura.

title: Sunday review: present simple and continuous
title_it: Ripasso della domenica: present simple e continuous
goal: Review the week: choose between present simple and continuous, avoid the common traps, and listen to something light.
goal_it: Ripassare la settimana: scegliere tra present simple e continuous, evitare le trappole più comuni e ascoltare qualcosa di leggero.

title: Past simple + prepositions of place + question words
title_it: Past simple + preposizioni di luogo + parole interrogative
goal: Talk about finished past actions, say where things are, and ask questions with where, when, who, why, which and whose.
goal_it: Parlare di azioni passate finite, dire dove sono le cose e fare domande con where, when, who, why, which e whose.

title: Past continuous + question words 2 + this / that
title_it: Past continuous + parole interrogative 2 + this / that
goal: Say what was happening at a moment in the past, ask how much, how many, how far, how long and how often, and use this, these, that and those.
goal_it: Dire cosa stava succedendo in un momento del passato, fare domande con how much, how many, how far, how long e how often, e usare this, these, that e those.

title: Listening: A new flat
goal: Understand a phone call about a new flat, and practise there is / there are, prepositions of place and the past simple.
goal_it: Capire una telefonata su un nuovo appartamento ed esercitare there is / there are, le preposizioni di luogo e il past simple.

title: Phrasal verbs of the week
goal: Learn ten useful phrasal verbs and see how to use them in different sentences.
goal_it: Imparare dieci phrasal verbs utili e vedere come usarli in frasi diverse.

title: Reading: At the airport
goal: Check in, pass security and find your gate.
goal_it: Fare il check-in e trovare il gate.

title: Reading: Asking for directions
goal: Ask the way and understand the answer.
goal_it: Chiedere la strada e capire la risposta.

title: Reading: At a restaurant
goal: Book a table, order food and ask for the bill.
goal_it: Prenotare, ordinare e chiedere il conto.

title: Reading: Shopping for clothes
title_it: Lettura: Fare shopping per i vestiti
goal: Ask for a size, try something on and pay.
goal_it: Chiedere una taglia, provare un capo e pagare.

title: Reading: At the doctor's and at the pharmacy
title_it: Lettura: Dal medico e in farmacia
goal: Describe simple symptoms and understand advice and instructions.
goal_it: Descrivere sintomi semplici e capire consigli e istruzioni.

title: Reading: At the hotel
goal: Check in, ask about breakfast and report problems in your room.
goal_it: Fare il check-in, chiedere della colazione e segnalare problemi in camera.

title: Yellow
goal: Learn the words first, notice irregular past verbs and would, and think about what the narrator does for love.
goal_it: Impara prima le parole, nota i verbi irregolari al passato e would, e pensa a cosa fa il narratore per amore.

title: Young and Beautiful
goal: Learn the words first, notice will, when and the present perfect, and think about what the song really asks.
goal_it: Impara prima le parole, nota will, when e il present perfect e pensa a cosa chiede davvero la canzone.

title: Starlight
goal: Learn the words first, notice will, if-clauses and the present continuous, and think about what the singer wants to hold on to.
goal_it: Impara prima le parole, nota will, le frasi con if e il present continuous, e pensa a cosa vuole tenere stretto il cantante.

title: This Is the Life
goal: Learn the words first, notice the past continuous and going to, and think about what a night out really feels like.
goal_it: Impara prima le parole, nota il past continuous e going to, e pensa a cosa si prova davvero in una serata fuori.
